gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-mada: Expressive Bushcraft keeps every curve at one stroke width and spaces its letters wide, while Mada stands tall, curves left open. Wire-like display lettering against a sans-serif with real stature is the draw.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-matangi: Wide-spaced and unshaded: Bushcraft closes its letters, while Matangi leaves its rounded forms open on a hefty, twine-pressed sans body. Bushcraft is happiest large; let Matangi stay modest in size.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-miriam-libre: Miriam Libre reads like drawn wire with a generous s, set against Bushcraft, whose letters stay closed and widely spaced. Give Miriam Libre a little extra size to use that stature.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-montserrat-under: Wire-bent and wide-spaced, Bushcraft is pure expression, its closed letters drawn without a swell. Montserrat Underline does the plain talking, with open counters and a sans-serif lowercase that towers over its capitals.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-nata-sans: Bushcraft spaces its closed, single-width letters wide and lets capitals sit close to lowercase height. Nata Sans, with its large central band and open curves, reads steadily over a long run, like a technical pen at work.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Noto Kufi Arabic reads modern and clean, its sans letters leaving a welcoming gap in the c. And Bushcraft, stressless in every curve, is where the expressive character lives.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-anatol: Modern in feel, Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs points its terminals outward and lifts its x-height close to cap height. While Bushcraft, wire-like and monoline, does the expressive showing off, the sans stays open.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-baline: Bushcraft: wide-spaced, unshaded and expressive to the last curve. Noto Sans Balinese breathes inside every curve with short ascenders, so a small Bushcraft heading would lose out to it.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Expressive Bushcraft spaces its closed letters wide, with no thinning anywhere. Beneath it, Noto Sans Bamum brings big open counters and curves that stop before turning inward, a lighter second voice.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-noto-sans-bhaiks: Noto Sans Bhaiksuki reads approachable, its coiled-rope lowercase swollen yet open at every aperture. But Bushcraft has no pressure swells to slow the eye, so a slightly larger body size lets Noto Sans Bhaiksuki hold its own.
